Hannah B: Heads-up: AMs want playbooks to trigger from post-onboard feedback (NPS/CSAT) but we have noisy sources. Proposing central routing rules so we only create tasks for negative feedback on high-touch accounts.

Owen L: what counts as negative feedback? NPS <= 6? CSAT <= 3? Also which sources (in-app survey, email, support ticket)?

Hannah B: proposal: trigger when ANY of these conditions met in last 7 days: NPS <=6 OR CSAT <=3 OR support_ticket_priority IN ('P0','P1') AND account_touch_type = 'high_touch'.

Maya T: sounds good. For low-touch accounts, we should enqueue a lightweight nurture (email + in-app guide) instead of an AM task.

Owen L: I'll draft the routing SQL used to identify events for staging filter:
```sql
SELECT account_id, source, score, touch_type
FROM feedback_events
WHERE occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days'
  AND (
    (source = 'nps' AND score <= 6)
    OR (source = 'csat' AND score <= 3)
    OR (source = 'support' AND priority IN ('P0','P1'))
  );
```

Hannah B: routing rules pseudocode:
```
if account.touch_type == 'high_touch' and feedback_is_negative:
  create AM task (tag: feedback-urgent)
else if feedback_is_negative:
  enqueue nurture sequence (tag: feedback-low-touch)
else:
  log event only
```

Maya T: add metadata on tasks: feedback_id, source, raw_score, survey_text, and last_contact_date. AMs want quick context.

Hannah B: gate conditions for rollout: in staging, at most 5% false positives on a 72h sample (AM feedback), and daily AM queue growth < 40% vs baseline. Also must include opt-out list for accounts with active remediation flows.

automation-bot: Created ticket CS-7001: "feedback-routing-playbook" assigned to Owen L, due 2025-11-04.

Owen L: will add a dry-run mode that posts to a test workspace and emits a CSV of candidate accounts. Sample curl for dry-run job: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://automations.redwood/api/v1/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"workflow":"feedback-routing","dry_run":true}'
```

Maya T: I'll prepare AM guidance and email templates for both urgent and low-touch flows. Also will add wording for how to mention survey context in the outreach.

Hannah B: owners: Hannah (owner), Owen (data/automation), Maya (enablement). Timeline: staging dry-run next Wed 2025-11-12, review on Fri 2025-11-14, target prod week of 2025-11-17.

Maya T: one more ask 1: include a column `survey_excerpt` truncated to 200 chars for AM review.

Owen L: noted. I will also expose model-version-like field `rule_version` so we can audit which routing logic applied.

Hannah B: thanks team  we'll reconvene after staging results. If anyone wants to volunteer to sanity-check the CSV, DM me. :sparkles:
